name: 5-nin no Koi Prince ~Himitsu no Keiyaku Kekkon~
original_name: 5人の恋プリンス ~ヒミツの契約結婚~
source:
The protagonist had led a normal everyday life working at her father's cake shop when she suddenly inherits a ridiculously large sum of money.
Even more, the condition to be able to get the inheritance is to marry one of a group of handsome brothers!?
translation:
主角在父亲的蛋糕店工作，过着正常的日常生活，突然继承了一大笔钱。
更何况，能够得到传承的条件，就是嫁给一群帅哥中的一个！？
